_comment: Data-driven panel list for the File tools hub. Each entry names a tool by its plugin folder under chisurf/plugins; the hub opens the plugin's emtk app (manifest entrypoints.emtk) on first selection. Add a tool by adding an entry here — no Python needed. Order runs from the format-level operations (convert, split) through the container (pack, read) to the metadata (header).
title: 🗂️ File tools

panels.name: TTTR Split / Convert
panels.description: Split large TTTR files into segments and convert between container formats.

panels.name: ⇄ .pto
panels.description: Pack a vendor photon file into a .pto container, or unpack the vendor file back out of one. Either direction keeps the dropped file and verifies the result byte-for-byte before anything is deleted.

panels.name: PTO Inspector
panels.description: Read a .pto back: every object in it, the payload as a table or a curve, the settings that are the recipe, and the provenance drawn as a graph. Opens the tool that performs a step.

panels.name: TTTR header
panels.description: View and edit the header tags of any TTTR file tttrlib can read — correcting metadata a vendor wrote, and adding tags of your own.

panels.name: TTTR → Time Windows
panels.description: Split TTTR files into fixed-duration time-window BID (.bst) files.

panels.name: BID → Analysis
panels.description: Convert burst-ID (BID) files into a burstwise analysis folder next to the TTTR data.

panels.name: MFD Prepare
panels.description: Prepare a burst folder for multiparameter-fluorescence (MFD) analysis: resolve photon sources, verify channel counts, compute mean micro times, and inspect the preparation report.
